description: Stable identifier for the record. Recommended format: YYYY-MM-DD_{INSTITUTION_CODE}_{NNNN}.
notes: Non-empty. No pattern enforced at Core. Implementation Profiles impose institution-specific patterns.

description: Date of interview in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
notes: Approximate or compound dates deferred to Phase 2.

description: Name(s) of the interviewer(s) as a single string. ORCID may follow each name in parentheses.
notes: Non-empty. Multivalue interviewer records deferred to Phase 2.

description: GDPR-based consent category. Free string at Core; see vocabs/consent_status.md for recommended vocabulary.
notes: Non-empty. No enum enforced at Core. If the value is withdrawn, accessRights MUST be closed (vocabs/consent_status.md). Implementation Profiles SHOULD specify a controlled vocabulary appropriate to their discipline and legal context. Values are case-sensitive, lowercase, exact strings; profiles MUST restrict input to their vocabulary plus withdrawn.

description: Repository-level access rights. One of: open | restricted | closed.
notes: Cross-domain stable: used by OpenAIRE, Zenodo, DataCite.

description: Stable reference to the governance record that documents the decisions applying to this interview (for example a DPO, ethics-panel or controller decision, or a class release record). The referenced record, not this field, states purpose, legal basis, permitted processing routes and permitted machine reuse.
notes: Non-empty when present. Internal reference; MUST NOT be exported as a public link. The Core does not restate or validate the content of the referenced record. Recommended forms: institutional identifier or URN. Profiles may impose a pattern.
Non-empty. No length limit at Core. Profiles may impose constraints.

description: Pseudonym or display name for the interviewee. Core-level minimal speaker hook.
notes: Full speaker component (demographics, life-history data) deferred to Phase 2.

description: ISO 639-3 three-letter language code (e.g. eng / deu / fra).
notes: Single language only at Core. Multilingual interviews deferred to Phase 2.

description: Place of interview. Free string at Core.
notes: No controlled list enforced at Core. Profiles SHOULD specify a vocabulary appropriate to their geographic scope.

description: Subject keywords. Free string array at Core.
notes: Each keyword non-empty. No controlled vocabulary enforced at Core. Profiles SHOULD specify one.

description: Short descriptive (non-analytic) summary, 2–3 sentences. Describes the interview as a research object, not its analytic interpretation.
notes: See methodological-positions/abstracts.md and docs/README.md §7 for the descriptive-vs-analytic distinction.

description: Array of segment objects. Required sub-properties: start (HH:MM:SS), end (HH:MM:SS), label (string).
notes: Sub-property pattern for start and end: ^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$. Transcription and analytic annotation (codes, memos, links) are outside Core scope — see crosswalks/qdpx.md.

description: URLs or persistent identifiers of related materials (transcripts; companion documents; derived files).
notes: Recommend DOI or URL strings. No object structure imposed at Core; profiles may tighten.
